thread:
priya: Confidential ask  Im starting family therapy next week and my therapist recommends a gradual return-to-work over 3 weeks (half days then full days). Can People Ops help log a temporary flexible schedule and coordinate reduced meeting load? Im nervous about this showing up in my review.


danielle (People Ops): Thanks for telling us, @priya. We can absolutely support a short-term phased RTW (return-to-work). Well keep this confidential. Two options: 1) formal temporary accommodation case; 2) informal manager-managed plan. If you want documentation for benefits/STD or payroll, choose #1. Want us to open the case?

priya: Please open the case. I may need to use some sick/benefit days early in week 1. Also would like exemption from recurring all-hands and the Thurs 4pm cross-team sync for the period.

marc (Manager): Priya, Im here to support. Ill cover your 4pm sync and see if we can shift the all-hands attendance to async for you. For scheduling, do you want mornings only week 1, then 6-hour days week 2, then full week 3?

priya: That plan works. Week 1: 10am-2pm; Week 2: 9am-3pm; Week 3: 9am-5pm. Also request no critical PR ownership in week 1 and ability to delegate code review to the on-call reviewer.

danielle (People Ops): Noted. Ill open a confidential accommodation case and add the RTW schedule and meeting exceptions. We can coordinate with Benefits if you need to tap into short-term disability or mental health benefits. We can also connect you to EAP for therapy cost assistance if helpful.

eap_bot: EAP tip: Employees can access 6 free counseling sessions per issue. Book via https://redwood.internal/eap or DM EAP team. Notifications to People Ops only.

marc (Manager): I approve the PR reassignments and the phased schedule. Priya, please DM me your primary communication window and any tasks you want reassigned. Ill add manager notes so reviewers see context but we will not include clinical details.

priya: DM sent with task list. Also wondering if this will be visible to the performance committee. Im concerned about bias.

danielle (People Ops): Good question. Accommodation records are confidential and only visible to People Ops and your manager by default. We will not surface medical details to the performance committee. If helpful, we can add a private annotation for reviewers that simply notes a temporary RTW accommodation existed for dates XY without details.

priya: Yes please add that private note. Also would like the 30-day check-in between me, Marc, and People Ops. Happy to keep it short.

danielle (People Ops): Will do. Action: confidential-accommodation-created for priya (type: phased-RTW, start: 2287654321, planned-end: 2287973521). Check-in scheduled at 30 days. Notifications: People Ops and manager only. Ill DM you the case link and benefits info.

marc (Manager): Ill update team calendar and reroute the 4pm sync for the three-week window. Priya, take care and let us know if dates shift. :heart:

priya: Thank you both  feeling much better to have a confidential plan in place. Ill reach out if I need to extend.
